cards.existing: Compare `bod`-clauses (for verb-based facts) vs `mai`-clauses (for focused nouns). `Dw i'n meddwl bod e'n iawn` (I think he's right – fact) vs `mai e sy'n iawn` (it's him who's right – focus).
